One more: "objectives include joint_reach_holding_acceptance,terminal_error_m,holding_max_error_m,holding_max_speed_m_s (optional complete_update_s)". I'll list all five.

"constraints include frozen_acceptance,force_bounds,finite_valid_execution" — include exactly these (maybe plus nothing).

"verification includes candidate.apply,simulation.run,evaluation.run,control.profile_report,bound_comparison,diagnostic_revision" — as listed.

"fixed_conditions must include robot,task,acceptance,controller_implementation,other_numerical_settings."

Good. Write the call.

Now produce the final tool call with the full plan.

Also mention "state provider attempts if needed" — I'll note in fidelity_limits: "If provider state is needed, one attempt against the frozen provider bundle is charged within the future grant; no provider attempt is made in this stage." Already in the draft's fidelity limits last item.

Final answer: single tool call to design_submit_search_plan.
